name: OpenWork Mainnet Contract Registry

statusDefinitions.live: Runtime code and the configured production role were confirmed on-chain.
statusDefinitions.runtime-verified: The deployed runtime and immutable-aware hash were checked against the release artifact.
statusDefinitions.source-verified: The block explorer publishes matching source code.
statusDefinitions.source-pending: Runtime is live, but matching source has not yet been published on the block explorer.
statusDefinitions.proxy-linked: The explorer and ERC-1967 slot point at the current implementation.
statusDefinitions.configured: Required production pointers, routes or parameters were read back from live contracts.
statusDefinitions.end-to-end-tested: A production transaction completed and destination application state proved the full path.
statusDefinitions.disabled: The route or feature is intentionally not enabled in production.

native-openwork-genesis.detail: Active canonical job and lifecycle store used by NOWJC, NativeAthena and the read layer.

nowjc.detail: V5 is active with the replacement Native bridge authorized. Live commissionPercentage() and minCommission() both read zero.

native-arb-lowjc.detail: The direct Arbitrum adapter completed production job 42161-24 through escrow and final release on 7 August 2026 without LayerZero or CCTP.

native-arb-athena-client.detail: The V3 direct Arbitrum dispute, skill-verification and Ask Athena adapter is active against the canonical native contracts.

native-openwork-dao.detail: V2 is active with historical checkpoints, the ordered stake-sync receiver and the replacement Native bridge.

native-athena.detail: V9 is active with canonical dispute validation, XDC domain routing and the replacement Native bridge.

native-profile-genesis.detail: V2 is the active profile, portfolio and canonical job-bound rating store.

native-athena-activity-tracker.detail: The active tracker records oracle-member governance activity separately from NativeAthena.

native-athena-oracle-manager.detail: The active manager controls skill-oracle membership and lifecycle used by NativeAthena.

native-profile-manager.detail: V3 is active with canonical Job Genesis authorization and the replacement Native bridge pointer.

native-voting-power-checkpoints.detail: The Arbitrum checkpoint proxy was initialized, linked to NativeOpenworkDAO and seeded during the 19 July rollout.

native-dao-stake-sync.detail: The ordered, fail-closed stake receiver is initialized and routed from the replacement Native bridge into NativeOpenworkDAO and Genesis.

native-lz-openwork-bridge.detail: V3 is the active Arbitrum LayerZero router. Ethereum, Optimism and XDC peers plus send/receive security stacks were read back; only the XDC application path has a post-cutover end-to-end proof.

native-rewards.detail: The active rewards contract points to the current ProfileGenesis proxy and the replacement Native bridge.

arbitrum-cctp-transceiver.detail: The verified Arbitrum CCTP V2 transceiver has a 0.001 ETH reward cap and a live reward pool of 0.0004 ETH at the 7 August audit block.

native-contract-registry.detail: The on-chain lookup helper is live, but it is not the authoritative production address registry.

native-genesis-reader.detail: The active standalone reader provides batch, read-only access to canonical Genesis state.

optimism-lowjc.detail: The live Optimism job adapter retains its production pointers and routes application messages to Arbitrum. No post-cutover end-to-end application proof is recorded.

optimism-local-athena.detail: The live Optimism dispute and skill-oracle adapter is wired to the local job, bridge and CCTP contracts.

optimism-local-bridge.detail: The active Optimism LayerZero bridge peers with Native bridge V3 on Arbitrum; its production security stack was read back, but no post-cutover application delivery proof is recorded.

optimism-cctp-transceiver.detail: The verified Optimism CCTP V2 transceiver has a 0.001 ETH reward cap and a live reward pool of 0.00002 ETH at the 7 August audit block.

xdc-lowjc.detail: V3 is active with applicant-milestone callbacks and the replacement XDC bridge; production job 30365-3 completed after the cutover.

xdc-local-athena.detail: The live XDC dispute and skill-oracle adapter points to the replacement XDC bridge. LocalAthena V2 remains intentionally undeployed.

xdc-local-bridge.detail: V2 is the active XDC LayerZero router. Its reciprocal Arbitrum path and four-DVN security stack are configured and production-tested.

xdc-cctp-transceiver.detail: The verified Standard Transfer adapter preserves the legacy selector. Its reward cap is 0.01 XDC and its live reward pool was 0.30 XDC at the 7 August audit block.

eth-openwork-dao.detail: V3 is active with snapshot voting power, the Ethereum checkpoint proxy and separated retryable DAO messaging.

eth-voting-power-checkpoints.detail: The Ethereum checkpoint proxy was initialized, linked to ETHOpenworkDAO and seeded during the 19 July rollout.

eth-dao-messaging.detail: The proxy is initialized as the exactly-once, retryable outbound governance messaging module for ETHOpenworkDAO.

eth-lz-openwork-bridge.detail: The active Ethereum LayerZero bridge peers with Native bridge V3 on Arbitrum; no post-cutover governance delivery proof is recorded.

eth-rewards.detail: The verified standalone rewards contract handles Ethereum reward claims and OWORK distribution.

openwork-token.detail: The verified Ethereum ERC-20 is the live OWORK governance and rewards token.

liveConfiguration.verificationScope: Live runtime code for 31 roles, all 19 ERC-1967 implementation slots, six active LayerZero peers, NOWJC fee storage, NativeRewards ProfileGenesis, and three CCTP reward pools and caps.

commission.detail: The V5 source declares initial defaults, but the live proxy retained zero values during the upgrade. Production documentation must use the proxy values.

layerZeroSecurity.detail: Arbitrum routes to Ethereum, Optimism and XDC use the locked send/receive libraries, executor configuration and four required DVNs with no optional DVNs. Ethereum uses 15 receive confirmations; Optimism and XDC use 20.

recentChanges.title: Arbitrum direct cycle reconfirmed
recentChanges.detail: Production job 42161-24 completed from exact 0.10 USDC approval and escrow through final release. No LayerZero, CCTP or configuration change was involved.

recentChanges.title: Keeper incentives restored
recentChanges.detail: All three live CCTP transceiver reward pools were funded; the XDC reward cap was raised to 0.01 XDC.

recentChanges.title: NativeRewards completed
recentChanges.detail: NativeRewards.profileGenesis was configured to the current ProfileGenesis proxy. No new contract was deployed.

recentChanges.title: Replacement bridges activated
recentChanges.detail: Native bridge V3 and XDC local bridge V2 became the active application pointers with applicant-milestone callback support.

recentChanges.title: Governance state made historical and ordered
recentChanges.detail: VotingPowerCheckpoints, ETHDAOMessaging and NativeDAOStakeSync were deployed, initialized and wired into the upgraded DAOs.

recentChanges.title: Lifecycle and rating upgrades
recentChanges.detail: NOWJC V5, ArbLOWJC V5, NativeAthena V9, ProfileGenesis V2 and ProfileManager V3 added canonical lifecycle, XDC routing and job-bound rating validation.

limitations: The 19 artifacts deployed on 19 July remain runtime-verified but pending explorer source publication.
NOWJC currently calculates zero platform commission because both live proxy settings are zero.
LocalAthena V2 exists in source but is intentionally not live pending a production dispute-minimum decision.
The old Arbitrum and XDC bridges remain deployed for rollback and in-flight compatibility but are not active application pointers.
Optimism/Arbitrum and Ethereum/Arbitrum are configured, but no post-cutover application or governance delivery proof is recorded.

pathways.name: Arbitrum direct (same chain)
pathways.detail: Jobs posted through ArbLOWJC V5 settle against NOWJC on Arbitrum with no LayerZero message and no CCTP transfer. Reconfirmed end to end on 7 August 2026: production job 42161-24 moved an exact 0.10 USDC through approval, escrow and final release.

pathways.name: XDC ↔ Arbitrum
pathways.detail: Reciprocal peers, explicit four-DVN security configuration and production job 30365-3 completed after the 19 Jul bridge cutover.

pathways.name: Optimism ↔ Arbitrum
pathways.detail: Reciprocal peers point to the active bridges and the V3 Native-bridge security stack was read back; no post-cutover end-to-end application test is recorded.

pathways.name: Ethereum ↔ Arbitrum
pathways.detail: Reciprocal peers point to the active bridges and the V3 Native-bridge security stack was read back; no post-cutover governance delivery test is recorded.
